items.title: Block (XYZ) Wins Back A Restaurant Franchise Customer For Square
items.summary: Block (NYSE:XYZ) said Cascadia Pizza Co. has returned to Square as its unified commerce platform for restaurant and franchise operations. Cascadia Pizza Co. is consolidating its dine in, takeout, mobile events and franchise locations on Square's upgraded restaurant tools. The move follows a reassessment of Square's expanded features, including franchise management, offline support for events and centralized multi location reporting.
